items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: Paterson and Jackson, two big guys. I used to hang around with them. We used to eat together

ctx.x: Yeah, they teamed up for some recording dates in the late '40s.

And there was another man, a trumpet player by the name of Jack Butler, we called him Jacques, like the French Jacques. Then there was another act there at the Moulin Rouge, Paterson and Jackson, two big guys. I used to hang around with them. We used to eat together because I love to eat and they liked to eat, I didn't want to be alone. Any Frenchman doesn't eat as much as I, but Pork Chop,
